name: AELDARI: ASURMEN
description: Asurmen's skill at war is breathtaking, the magnitude of his heroic presence so great that nearby Aspect Warriors are infused with his peerless tactical acumen. In addition to his wrist-mounted shuriken catapults known as the Bloody Twins, he carries the Sword of Asur, whose hilt bears the spirit stone of Asurmen's brother, Tethesis.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds Asurmen – the legendary Phoenix Lord of the Dire Avengers Aspect Warriors – for use in your Aeldari armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. As is the case with the warriors of his shrine, he is a versatile and deadly foe, skilled at the art of war both in strategic terms and death-dealing on the field of battle.</br></br>This kit contains 14 plastic components, and 1x Citadel 40mm Round Base. This miniature is supplied unassembled and unpainted – we recommend Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
